BenefitUnlimitedComponent.bdBenefitUnlimitedDescription: Plan covers up to two oral exams per year.
Plan covers dental x-rays, and coverage frequency varies. For example, plan covers bitewing x-rays once per year and panoramic x-rays once every three years.
Plan covers up to two basic cleanings per year.
Plan covers up to two fluoride treatments per year.
Plan covers restorative services, such as fillings, once per surface every two years.
Plan covers endodontic services, such as root canal treatments, once per tooth per lifetime.
Plan covers periodontal services, such as deep cleaning, once every three years.
Plan covers dentures (once every five years)
Plan covers fixed prosthodontics, such as the fake tooth (pontic) of the bridge, every five years.
Plan covers routine or surgical extractions once per tooth per lifetime.
Plan covers non-routine service such as pain treatment once per year.
